scope: Corrections found during pre-publication checking; neither changes the computed periodic roots nor the storage identities.

corrections.check: Repeated-precision comparison of exported storage constants
corrections.initial_result: The p enclosures appeared disjoint when rebuilding an interval from separately rounded midpoint and radius display fields.
corrections.cause: Decimal rounding of the displayed midpoint was not included in the displayed internal radius. The difference was 4.55e-79 for a displayed radius of 3.59e-79.
corrections.correction: Export and compare Arb joint ball strings, which include decimal rounding; keep the other fields for display. The storage computation itself is unchanged.

corrections.check: Visual inspection of the saddle and attracting-cycle portrait
corrections.initial_result: A spurious vertical line joined the last sample to the wrong half-cycle section point.
corrections.cause: The plotting helper did not wrap a time exactly equal to the complete period before selecting its symmetry sign.
corrections.correction: Reduce time modulo the full period before selecting the half-period. Orbit records and certificates are unchanged.
